primary_rule: The primary sector is the test of record. It stays the test of record whatever its result, including INSUFFICIENT, CLOCK_UNVERIFIED or INVALID_INPUT; it is never replaced by a later sector. Later listed sectors are scored separately with their own configs and reported as further tests, never pooled with the primary.
